candidate_pool: Fixed factorial eight candidates per block; no proposals or range changes after outcomes; candidate occurrence IDs preserved.

arms.original_rms: Minimize original float32 max_batch RMS(probability)*RMS(hidden)/RMS(kernel), including tail. Preserve as baseline; original threshold0.1 logged but not applied.
arms.head_trace: Minimize sample-weighted mean_i (1-||p_i||_2^2)||h_i||_2^2; p reconstructed in float64 from the affine head with numerical agreement checks. Exact kernel-only mean-CE Hessian trace, not full-network curvature.
arms.early_tuning_ce: Minimize actual compiled Keras CE on common tuning rows at one-epoch probe.
arms.random: Shuffle sorted common eligible candidate IDs with fixed selection seed, take first2; independent of scores and outcomes.

geometry.parameters: Output kernel only in ordinary Euclidean/Frobenius coordinates; output bias and penultimate features fixed during perturbation interpretation.
geometry.noise_convention: Fixed per-coordinate isotropic covariance sigma^2 I on head coordinates in the local sensitivity identity; no noise is sampled in this pilot and no radius or sigma is tuned. Architecture and head dimensions are fixed across candidates.
geometry.limitations: Raw trace changes under compensating feature/kernel rescaling and neuron duplication. It does not bound full-network curvature, guarantee classification quality, or order eventual accuracy. Positive trace is not required; zero trace is recorded.

eligibility.common: Every attempted probe retained. Select only complete candidates with finite positive original RMS, finite nonnegative trace and finite tuning CE. All arms use exactly this common subset.
eligibility.failed_or_zero_rms: Consumes candidate slot; excluded from every arm; no replacement/refill. Conclusions conditional on nondegenerate original-score candidates.
eligibility.insufficient_pool: Abort comparison before evaluation if fewer than2 eligible candidates per block.
eligibility.final_failures: Any shortlisted final not complete aborts the entire comparison before evaluation; all partial cost and checkpoints retained. No alternate finalist or incumbent chosen.

lifecycle.probe: One epoch with constant candidate LR. Shared fitting sample and shared phase shuffle; scores measured on all1500 fit rows in shared seeded order.
lifecycle.final: Fresh candidate-and-phase-keyed initialization, no probe state reused; Adam with candidate WD and cosine LR over100*ceil(1500/64)=2400 updates; at most100epochs.
lifecycle.checkpoint: Actual Keras EarlyStopping monitor=val_loss,patience25,min_delta0,restore_best_weightsTrue. Lowest compiled tuningCE checkpoint restored. Terminal optimizer state retained, no resume claim.
lifecycle.arm_incumbent: Among its two fully trained restored finalists, maximize tuning accuracy, then minimize tuning CE, then lexicographic candidateID. All four arms fixed before any heldout model evaluation.
lifecycle.union_reuse: Train each unique shortlisted candidate once per block; reuse identical saved result for all arms selecting it.

seeds.recipe: SHA256 compact JSON [fghpo-four-arm-v1,kmnist,block,candidate_id,phase,role], first4bytes big-endian masked0x7fffffff.
seeds.initialization: CandidateID, phase probe/final, role initialization; independent of rank, arm or attempted order.
seeds.augmentation: None in fixed MNIST-shaped CNN builder.

evaluation.primary: Heldout top1 classification error count out of1000, error rate and complementary accuracy; lower error preferred.
evaluation.secondary: No loss-based outcome interpretation; report tuning CE/accuracy only as selection/protocol evidence. No all-candidate heldout correlation or oracle regret.
evaluation.lock: Write complete probes,shortlists,finals,costs and all-block arm decisions, hash durable decisions file, then load evaluation arrays and verify lock unchanged.
evaluation.evaluated_models: Only distinct arm incumbent checkpoints, at most8; shared incumbents evaluated once. Save probabilities,predictions,labels and checkpoint hashes for record-only verification.
evaluation.holdout_policy: KMNIST official-test subset frozen independently; new to available project evidence. It becomes spent for adaptive follow-up once outcomes are inspected. No parameter, direction, checkpoint-policy or eligibility change after outcomes.
evaluation.interpretation: Two initialization blocks on one shared small-data split; descriptive exploratory evidence only. No statistical significance, method superiority or full-data KMNIST/CIFAR claim.

cost.provider: Local Mac CPU only;2intra-op/1inter-op threads, no accelerator, no paid resource.
cost.maximum_phase_counts: 16one-epoch probes and at most16union finalfits; at most1616epochs/38784optimizerupdates.
cost.wall_bound: 870seconds cooperative measured after input loading;900seconds hard entire subprocess includingimports. On timeout retain incomplete evidence and do not launch another run automatically.
cost.physical: Shared16probes plus union finalfits and distinct-incumbent evaluation.
cost.logical: Each arm/block charged common8probes and its2finalfits; report seconds and epochcounts separately. Shared computation is not independent repeated-arm execution. Standalone random need not incur probe work.

preparation_disclosure: Mechanical data preparation read and copied the fixed official-test arrays and validated shapes/dtypes/label range. No models, predictions, outcome summaries, class counts, or sample plots were used before this freeze.
